name: ordered
sql: SELECT v FROM n ORDER BY v;

name: grouped
sql: SELECT v,count(*) FROM n GROUP BY v ORDER BY v;

name: filtered
sql: SELECT sum(v),min(v) FROM n WHERE v>=5;

name: join
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM n a JOIN n b ON a.v=b.v;

name: schema
sql: SELECT name,type FROM sqlite_schema ORDER BY name;
